posts.title: The Short King Is Dead, Long Live The Short King
posts.description: USV’s larger funds let it lead bigger rounds without chasing capital-intensive, round-after-round growth. It backs strong teams for durable returns, from billion-dollar companies and beyond.

posts.title: The Clarity Act
posts.description: The Clarity Act is far from perfect, but after fifteen years of regulatory chaos, crypto desperately needs clear rules. Congress must pass this bipartisan legislation before the August recess.

posts.title: My Pele Agent
posts.description: I've been playing around with agent harnesses since OpenClaw dropped at the start of the year. I've been particularly interested in agents who have money and can transact for me. So I've been doing the classic Chris Dixon weekend hobby thing and hacking around on fun stuff that isn't the least bit mission-critical to anyone.
